watch.text: Clemson lost QB Tait Reynolds for the season and backup Christopher Vizzina was hurt; it beat Duke 20-10 Friday with a Pearman/Denson QB rotation.
QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) missed the Arkansas loss and returned vs Georgia on Nov. 21 (87 passing yards, 1 INT in a 34-6 loss); our ratings carry the game without him.
WR Mazeo Bennett Jr., DB Judge Collier and edge Anthony Addison were downgraded to out for Georgia on Friday; WR Nyck Harbor is available.
QB Billy Edwards Jr. (upper body, hurt Nov. 14 vs Louisville) did not start at Virginia; freshman Travis Burgess made his first start in a 41-24 loss on Nov. 21.
QB Aidan Chiles (upper body) is out vs Minnesota, his third straight missed game; our ratings still lean on games he started.
QB Julian Sayin has missed every game since Oct. 17 with Luke Fahey starting; Rotowire lists an estimated return of Nov. 28 (Michigan). Not confirmed by Ohio State.
Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with Luke Fahey at QB, its 4th loss; our ratings run through Week 11 and do not include it yet.
QB Katin Houser is not likely to play vs Iowa after broken-nose surgery; Michael Clayton II starts. The line moved from Iowa -6.5 to -9.5.
QB AJ Swann was hurt again at Auburn and is out vs Tennessee Tech; Mississippi State is down to its third-string QB.
RB Fluff Bothwell was out vs Tennessee Tech on Nov. 21 and star WR Anthony Evans III left that game hurt.
WR Mike Matthews (knee) and OL Nic Moore are out for the season, the 11th Vol lost this year; QB George MacIntyre was expected to play vs LSU.
FSU had its top four RBs out (No. 5 Zay Parks started) in the 28-10 home loss to NC State on Nov. 21; edge Rylan Kennedy and RB Amari Thomas are out for the season.
Edge Rylan Kennedy is reported out for the season and FSU has 23 players ruled out vs NC State; RB Amari Thomas is also out for the year.
Star edge Colin Simmons was ruled out vs Arkansas (Nov. 21) and DB Kobe Black left that game with what looked like a significant injury.
DT Hero Kanu is out for the season after surgery for a torn biceps.
Michigan ruled out 3 offensive linemen for UCLA and WR JJ Buchanan is likely out for the season.
Michigan beat No. 4 UCLA in triple overtime on Nov. 21 despite three OL starters out; our ratings run through Week 11 and do not include it yet.
Nebraska beat Ohio State 31-28 on Nov. 21 despite several defensive starters being out; that result is not in our Week 11 ratings yet.
Defensive starter Francis Brewu is off the injury report and returns for SMU.
S Luke Talich left the Nov. 21 SMU win in the 1st quarter and WR Jaden Greathouse was also hurt; CB Leonard Moore was banged up. No timelines yet.
QB Jaden Craig was doubtful vs Utah on Nov. 21 and backup Adam Schobel was expected to make his first career start; ratings were built with Craig.
RB Dierre Hill Jr. left the Nov. 20 Michigan State win with a lower-body injury and was in a walking boot afterward; status for Washington unknown.
QB Keelon Russell (ankle) sat out the Nov. 21 Chattanooga win; DeBoer expects him 'full speed, full go' this week for Auburn, so our ratings likely see the right QB.
QB Jared Curtis re-aggravated an old wrist injury late in the Nov. 21 Florida loss and returned; Clark Lea does not expect a long-term problem.
QB Steve Angeli left the 27-15 loss at Boston College on Nov. 21 in the 3rd quarter with his right arm in a sling; Malachi Nelson finished. No timeline yet.
Florida beat Vanderbilt on Nov. 21 (Vanderbilt trailed 34-27 late); that result is not in our Week 11 ratings yet.
QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in OT of the Nov. 21 loss to Michigan (apparent knee/lower-body injury, no diagnosis); starter Nico Iamaleava is already out for the season.
Kentucky lost RB CJ Baxter and Malachi Wood to injuries in the Nov. 21 Missouri loss; no update from Will Stein.
Starting LB Luke Mergott left the Nov. 21 Clemson loss (20-10) with an injury; no status yet.
NC State won 28-10 at Florida State on Nov. 21 (CJ Bailey 292 yds, 3 TD), not in our Week 11 ratings yet; RB Duke Scott was hurt again in the game.
RB Kewan Lacy is out for the season and RB Shekai Mills-Knight has a high ankle sprain (Pete Golding, Nov. 17); our ratings were built mostly with Lacy.
QB Mason Heintschel tore his ACL in early October; Pitt is 1-5 since, but our ratings still carry his early games.
Starting QB Tayven Jackson (upper body) misses the UAB game; Chris Jimerson Jr. starts and backup Chaston Ditta is also hurt.

401858537.summary: Both QBs are hurt (Chiles and Houser), which explains some of the gap but not 8 points; both teams played Saturday and those results are not in our ratings yet.

reasons.text: QB Aidan Chiles (upper body) is ruled out vs Minnesota, his third straight missed game.
QB Katin Houser is not likely to play vs Iowa after surgery on a broken nose, Bret Bielema said Tuesday; Michael Clayton II has started in his absence.

swings.Illinois: QB Katin Houser is not likely to play vs Iowa after broken-nose surgery (Nov 17); the market marked Illinois down, our ratings haven't yet.
swings.Northwestern: QB Aidan Chiles has missed three straight games (Nov 19); the market rates Northwestern without him, our ratings still carry his starts.

401856765.summary: Tennessee's 11 season-ending injuries are real but small next to a 13-point gap; Vanderbilt QB Jared Curtis's wrist is not expected to be a long-term issue.

reasons.text: WR Mike Matthews (knee) and OL Nic Moore are out for the season; Moore is the 11th Vol lost for the year.
QB Jared Curtis re-aggravated an old wrist injury late in the Florida loss and returned; Clark Lea expects him to practice this week.

swings.Tennessee: Nothing found: the market moved on Tennessee without a clear reason beyond its 11 season-ending injuries (OL Nic Moore the latest, Nov 19).
swings.Vanderbilt: Vanderbilt lost to Florida on Nov. 21 and QB Jared Curtis hurt his wrist late (not expected to be long-term); nothing else found to explain the move.

401858313.summary: UNC QB Billy Edwards Jr. missed the 41-24 loss at Virginia with freshman Travis Burgess starting; that covers part of an 11.6-pt gap. We have been lower on UNC than the market lately.

reasons.text: QB Billy Edwards Jr. (upper body) was a game-time decision and did not start at Virginia; Travis Burgess made his first start in a 41-24 loss.
WR Keenan Jackson, Will Wilson and Chase Bond are out vs Florida State; Popo Aguirre is probable.
NC State beat Florida State 28-10 on Nov. 21, outscoring it 21-0 after halftime; RB Duke Scott was hurt again.

swings.North Carolina: QB Billy Edwards Jr. (upper body) did not start at Virginia on Nov. 21 and freshman Travis Burgess started in a 41-24 loss (Tar Heel Tribune).
swings.NC State: NC State won 28-10 at Florida State on Nov. 21 (CJ Bailey 292 yds, 3 TD, per AP), which our Week 11 ratings don't include yet; no other news found.

401858540.summary: Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska and Michigan beat No. 4 UCLA in 3OT on Saturday, neither in our Week 11 ratings; that covers part of the gap. Sayin's return is unconfirmed.

reasons.text: QB Julian Sayin (throwing arm, hurt Oct. 17 at Indiana) remains sidelined; freshman Luke Fahey has started. Ryan Day gave an encouraging Sayin update this week; no return date.
Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with Luke Fahey at QB, its 4th loss of the season.
Michigan beat No. 4 UCLA in triple overtime on Nov. 21 despite three OL starters out.

swings.Ohio State: Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with QB Julian Sayin still out (Eleven Warriors); the market marked the Buckeyes down, our Week 11 ratings have not.

401856873.summary: Nothing in the news explains it: Arizona won 35-28 in OT at Kansas State and Arizona State blew a 17-point lead in a 30-27 OT loss to Oklahoma State on Nov. 21, both pushing toward our side.

reasons.text: Arizona beat Kansas State 35-28 in OT on Nov. 21; Noah Fifita threw for 323 yards and 2 TDs. Not in our Week 11 ratings yet.
Arizona State lost 30-27 in OT to Oklahoma State on Nov. 21 after leading by 17 at halftime; QB Jake Fette threw the OT interception.

swings.Arizona: Nothing found: the market moved on Arizona without a clear reason; Arizona's 35-28 OT win at Kansas State on Nov. 21 points the other way.

401856764.summary: Clemson beat Duke 20-10 with a QB rotation and South Carolina lost without Sellers, then lost 34-6 to Georgia with him back; that explains part of it.

reasons.text: QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) sat vs Arkansas and returned vs Georgia on Nov. 21, a 34-6 loss.
QB Tait Reynolds (knee surgery) is out for the season and backup Christopher Vizzina was also hurt vs Georgia Tech. Clemson is turning to its third-string QB for Duke.

swings.Clemson: Clemson lost QB Tait Reynolds for the season and backup Vizzina was hurt (Nov 17); it still beat Duke 20-10 Friday with a QB rotation, and the market stayed on Clemson.

401856759.summary: FSU's injuries (top four RBs out, edge Rylan Kennedy lost for the year), its 28-10 home loss to NC State and Florida's win over Vanderbilt on Saturday explain part of the gap.

reasons.text: FSU lost 28-10 at home to NC State on Nov. 21 with its top four RBs out; Ashton Daniels threw 2 INTs. Not in our Week 11 ratings yet.
Starting edge Rylan Kennedy is reported out for the season; FSU downgraded two more starters and has 23 players ruled out vs NC State.
Starting RB Amari Thomas is expected to miss the rest of the season after being hurt vs Pittsburgh.

401858543.summary: UCLA QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in Saturday's loss to Michigan with Nico Iamaleava already out; that covers part of a 13.5-pt gap, but the market had USC -10.5 before it.

reasons.text: QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in OT of the Nov. 21 loss to Michigan with an apparent knee/lower-body injury; no diagnosis yet.
Nico Iamaleava is already out for the season (torn ACL), so Madden Iamaleava would likely start for UCLA.
DraftKings listed USC -10.5 on Nov. 16; the SP+ projection is UCLA by 6.8, close to our line.

swings.UCLA: QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in OT of the Nov. 21 triple-OT loss to Michigan (CBS Sports); our ratings do not see it, the market does.
swings.USC: Mostly the other side of UCLA's QB injury: Ty Dieffenbach was carted off Nov. 21 vs Michigan, so the market moved toward USC (CBS Sports).

401856761.summary: Nothing in the news explains it; Kentucky lost at Missouri on Nov. 21 and lost RB CJ Baxter and Malachi Wood to injuries in that game.

reasons.text: WR Nic Anderson (questionable) is trending toward playing vs Missouri; Jahlil Florence is also questionable.

401856757.summary: Alabama QB Keelon Russell is expected back for the Iron Bowl after resting his ankle, so his absence no longer explains the market sitting 3 points below us on Alabama.

reasons.text: Kalen DeBoer expects QB Keelon Russell (ankle) to be 'full speed, full go' in practice this week after sitting out the Chattanooga game.
Auburn beat FCS Samford 59-10 on Nov. 21; Tristan Ti'a threw for 341 yards and four first-half TDs.

swings.Auburn: No Auburn injury news found; Auburn beat FCS Samford 59-10 on Nov. 21 (Tristan Ti'a 341 yds), and Alabama QB Keelon Russell sat out Chattanooga before being expected back.

swings.Mississippi State: QB AJ Swann is out (Clarion-Ledger, Nov. 19), RB Fluff Bothwell missed the Nov. 21 game and WR Anthony Evans III left it hurt.
swings.Ole Miss: Nothing found: the market moved on Ole Miss without a clear reason (it lost RB Kewan Lacy for the season, which points the other way); its last game was vs FCS Wofford.

401856762.summary: Mississippi State is down to its third-string QB with RB Fluff Bothwell out and WR Anthony Evans III hurt; the line has moved from Ole Miss -14.5 to -19.5.

reasons.text: QB Kamario Taylor is out for the season (foot surgery, announced Oct. 27) and fill-in AJ Swann was hurt again at Auburn, leaving the third-string QB.
RB Fluff Bothwell missed the Nov. 21 Tennessee Tech game and WR Anthony Evans III left it hurt (see Mississippi State's Injury Wire).

401866472.summary: Forecast wind of about 16 mph (gusts 30+) at Akron and our SP+ input running far above Sagarin explain part of the gap; no new Buffalo or Akron injury news found.

reasons.text: Forecast for Nov. 27 at Akron: wind about 16 mph with gusts over 30, which tends to compress margins toward the underdog.
Buffalo QB E. Holmes (knee) was shut down for the season about three weeks ago; the market has had time to price it.

swings.Buffalo: Buffalo has won six straight (40-21 over Central Michigan on 11/18, Messiah Burch 200 rush yds); our ratings rose with the streak more than the market, which still prices QB E. Holmes's season-ending knee injury (UB Athletics).

swings.Kent State: Kent State lost 20-3 to Miami (OH) on Nov. 17 with QB Dru DeShields held to 92 passing yards; no injury news found, the market marked Kent State down after the loss.

401858314.summary: Syracuse QB Steve Angeli left Saturday's loss at Boston College with his arm in a sling and Malachi Nelson finished; that covers the 3.6-pt gap. Notre Dame has its own new injuries.

reasons.text: QB Steve Angeli left the 27-15 loss at Boston College in the 3rd quarter with his right arm in a sling; Malachi Nelson finished. No timeline.
Pushes the other way: Notre Dame lost S Luke Talich and WR Jaden Greathouse to injuries vs SMU on Nov. 21.

401871062.summary: Jacksonville State has already clinched its CUSA title-game spot (vs Liberty), so this game means less to it; Delaware just won 42-30 behind 5 TD passes. SP+ (-9.4) is far from Sagarin (-0.3).

reasons.text: Jax State clinched a third straight CUSA title-game berth with a 25-20 comeback win over Missouri State on Nov. 21; Liberty is the opponent.
Delaware QB Nick Minicucci threw 5 TDs (31-of-41, 398 yds) in a 42-30 win at New Mexico State; the Blue Hens are 6-5 and bowl-eligible.

swings.Delaware: Delaware won 42-30 at New Mexico State on Nov. 21 with Nick Minicucci throwing 5 TDs; the market moved up on the Blue Hens, while Jax State has a title game next (ESPN, 11/21).

401864549.summary: No injury or QB news found for either team; San José State lost 24-22 to UNLV on a failed 2-point try. Our line leans on SP+ (-22.6) far more than Sagarin (-10.2).

reasons.text: San José State (5-7) fell 24-22 to UNLV on Nov. 21 when Luke Weaver's tying 2-point pass fell incomplete; Weaver started and played the whole game.

401871063.summary: Liberty (10-1, 7-0 CUSA) has clinched the CUSA title game, so this regular-season finale is low-stakes for it; no injury news found. SP+ and our model run far above Sagarin.

reasons.text: Liberty had already clinched a CUSA title-game spot before Week 12 and will face Jacksonville State.
Liberty beat Western Kentucky 45-14 on Nov. 21 for its 10th straight win; QB Deshawn Purdie threw for 344 yds, no injuries reported.

401862843.summary: North Texas starting QB Tayven Jackson will miss the UAB game (upper body), with sophomore Chris Jimerson Jr. starting and backup Chaston Ditta also hurt; our ratings were built with Jackson.

reasons.text: Neal Brown: Jackson 'will definitely miss Saturday and then the UAB game as well'; he hopes Jackson is back for a title or bowl game.
Chris Jimerson Jr. starts until Jackson returns; backup Chaston Ditta has been out since an October injury.

401858315.summary: Pitt is 1-5 since QB Mason Heintschel tore his ACL in early October and its starter vs Cal is unclear; our ratings, especially SP+ (-20.1), still carry his early-season games.

reasons.text: Pittsburgh is 1-5 since losing QB Mason Heintschel (torn ACL); Holden Geriner struggled and was pulled for freshman Corey Dailey, starter vs Cal unclear. Opened Pitt -7.5.
Heintschel's season ended with a torn ACL.

401858316.summary: No SMU injury news found; Stanford just beat Cal 44-28 to reach bowl eligibility, which may have lifted the market on the Cardinal. Most of the gap comes from SP+ (-19.4 vs Sagarin -8.3).

reasons.text: Stanford won the Big Game 44-28 at Cal on Nov. 21 (Davis Warren 2 TD, Micah Ford 151 rush yds) and is 6-5, bowl-eligible for the first time since 2018.

401866475.summary: UMass QB Pop Watson's ankle is a question mark after the 34-33 loss to Akron, which could explain part of the market's lean to Bowling Green; SP+ (-6.4) and Sagarin (+2.8) disagree.

reasons.text: UMass QB Pop Watson's availability after an ankle injury was flagged before the Akron game; no update found for the Bowling Green trip.
Bowling Green's offense has been opened up for QB Jay Kastanin, per a Nov. 20 Toledo preview.

401866474.summary: Central Michigan's starting QB Angel Flores is out for the season after ankle surgery (Jadyn Glasser starts), and CMU just lost 40-21 at Buffalo; our ratings still carry some Flores games.

reasons.text: Angel Flores will miss the rest of 2026 after ankle surgery, per Mitten Football; Jadyn Glasser starts in his place.
Buffalo beat Central Michigan 40-21 on Nov. 18 behind Messiah Burch's 200 rushing yards.

401864550.summary: No injury or QB news found for UTEP or Northern Illinois; our sources split (Sagarin NIU -3.4, SP+ UTEP -2.5, our model NIU -6.8).

401862841.summary: No Army or Rice injury news found this week; the Army-Navy game follows, but nothing reported suggests Army is holding back.

401858311.summary: Miami is still without WR Malachi Toney (ankle surgery, likely out vs BC) and TE Elija Lofton left the Virginia Tech game hurt; real but small next to a 3.7-point gap.

reasons.text: Toney had surgery on a high ankle sprain from a Nov. 4 practice; Cristobal says he is about 1.5 weeks out, so the BC game looks unlikely.

401862842.summary: No Navy or Charlotte injury news found; Navy won 38-34 at Memphis on a late fourth-down TD, a result our ratings credited more than the market did.

reasons.text: Navy beat Memphis 38-34 on Nov. 21; Vic Listorti's 6-yard TD run on fourth down came with 15 seconds left.

swings.Navy: Navy's 38-34 win over Memphis on a last-minute fourth-down TD (11/21) raised our ratings more than the market; no injury news found (ESPN).

401860928.summary: No Texas State or Utah State injury or QB news found for this game; all three of our sources agree on Texas State by 10-12.

401869930.summary: Nothing current found: App State QB Malachi Singleton's status has changed several times this season (out Oct. 11, later available) and no update for South Alabama turned up.

401862839.summary: No Tulane or USF injury news found for this game; USF QB Michael Van Buren left the ECU game in early November with an undisclosed injury and no follow-up was found.

reasons.text: USF QB Michael Van Buren left in the second quarter with an undisclosed injury; the staff said an injury report would follow.

401864547.summary: No Hawai'i or Sacramento State (2-9) injury news found; nothing explains the market's shorter number.

swings.Georgia State: Backup QB Ayden Pereira threw 3 TDs in the 28-27 loss at Marshall (11/21) with Cameran Brown listed doubtful; the market moved up on Georgia State after the strong showing (Georgia State Athletics).

swings.Marshall: Carlos Del Rio-Wilson made his first start since Oct. 10 in the 28-27 win over Georgia State (11/21) after Zion Turner and Khalil Wilkins were hurt; our ratings rose, the market less so (WCHS).

401858544.summary: Wisconsin's QB job is unsettled (Colton Joseph vs freshman Ryan Hopkins, who was hurt) and injuries are piling up on defense, which covers part of a 4.4-point gap in a rivalry game.

reasons.text: Wisconsin has a QB decision for Black Friday between Colton Joseph and Ryan Hopkins; the writer argues for Joseph.
